furniture.name: DROWNING CABINET
furniture.perk_text: Increases Flooding Weapon Damage for targets with Severe Damage. When dealing damage to a target with reduced Max Hull Health, Flooding Weapons deal 15% more weapon damage for 20s with a 60s cooldown. Flooded status applied to targets within 250m lasts 12% longer. -10% reload time for Flooding Weapons. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: BLOODY RED
furniture.perk_text: A large banner stained red to incite vengeance, drawing the enemy's ire. Reduces Threat Generation of nearby friendly ships by 60%. Increases Taunt Bonus Threat by 40%. Increases Threat Generation by 25%. Ship rank 4. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: HELLSHOT SMITHY
furniture.perk_text: A forbidden shipboard forge, built to enhance the Ablaze status effect and spread Burning damage across enemy targets. Dealing at least 2000 Burning Damage in a single hit to a target applies the Charred status effect to them for 30s. While Charred, targets receive 30% more Burning Damage from your ship and increase the Torn Sails status charge received by 15%. Charred targets that are also Ablaze will build Charred status on targets within 150m. 10% of the Burning Damage dealt to a target which is Ablaze is also dealt to enemy ships within 150m. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: DOUBLE-PLANKED HULL I
furniture.perk_text: Increases Max Hull Health by 5%.

furniture.name: ORGAN HARVESTING STATION
furniture.perk_text: Rocket perks: +5% rocket damage per 20% hull health missing, +10% rocket secondary damage, -5% rocket reload time. Ship rank 4.

furniture.name: COUNTERTHRUST LOCKER
furniture.perk_text: +300% acceleration for 5s after ramming, +10% top speed and -10% crew stamina depletion when sailing against the wind. Ship rank 4.

furniture.name: STERILE GALLEY I
furniture.perk_text: +7% maximum stamina. Ship rank 1.

furniture.name: DYNAMIC BALLAST CONTROL
furniture.perk_text: Reduces incoming secondary damage by range (capped at 30% reduction at 600m and beyond), -8% incoming enemy piercing charge, +3% equipped armor rating. Ship rank 4.

furniture.name: BREECHLOCK FURNACE
furniture.perk_text: Ha! What a shot! In one end and clean out the other! +20% secondary damage up close (scaling down 2% per 50m of distance), +5% Shell-shocked charge rate, +3% Shell-shocked damage. Ship rank 4.

furniture.name: GRINDSTONE I
furniture.perk_text: +5% projectile speed for all weapons except Sea Fire and auxiliary weapons. Ship rank 1.

furniture.name: Rope Locker
furniture.perk_text: Oi, lad! Use a spoon to wipe your ass? That's the trim rope, not the anchor line! Increases Acceleration to 450% when trim is activated at full Stamina. 7% of Stamina is instantly consumed to trigger this effect. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: First Aid Station
furniture.perk_text: Increases repair weapon amount by 30% when hull health is below 33%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Signal Gong
furniture.perk_text: Increases weapon damage by 20% for 30s after using a Crew Attack. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Megaphone
furniture.perk_text: Increases reload speed by 0.5% per consecutive hit, up to a maximum of 15%. Effect resets if no hit is landed within 10s. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Scoping Station
furniture.perk_text: Keep yer eye on that enemy ship, lad! Don't let me catch ya sneaking winks at them mermaids! Hitting a target more than 320m away applies the Marked status. Targets with the Marked status take 100% more damage to weakpoints. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Scrapper Station
furniture.perk_text: A pickaxe, butter knife, or your damned left shoe! Patch the hull, me hearties! Restores 8000 Hull Health after a Crew Attack. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Iron Capstan
furniture.perk_text: Release the anchor, Captain! Those gutter swabs won't be able to hit us! Reduces damage taken by 15% and increases Threat Generation by 100% while Anchored. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Munitions Mixer
furniture.perk_text: Careful with that mix, you bastards! I'm not having my other brow seared off! Increases duration of Flooded and Ablaze effects applied to enemy ships by 100%, but reduces damage dealt from these effects by 20%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: War Drums
furniture.perk_text: Here they come, sea dogs! And if Davy Jones comes knocking, tell 'im we ain't ready for his locker yet! While trimming, reduces Brace Stamina Consumption by 50% and increases Armor Rating by 200. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Water Tank
furniture.perk_text: Reduces stamina depletion while bracing by 50% and increases stamina recovery by 20%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Rigging Station
furniture.perk_text: Grab yer tools, sea rats! We'll mend the hull faster than they make holes in it! Recovers 1% Hull Health per second when Hull Health is less than 20%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Gunner's Quadrant
furniture.perk_text: Decreases Reload Time by 15% for the same weapon used to hit a weakpoint from at least 160m range. The effect after hitting a weakpoint lasts for 10 seconds and applies only to the first shot. (Reworked in Y2S1; pre-Y2S1: -50% reload time on the first shot after destroying a weakpoint from at least 320m.) Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Freeman's Embrace
furniture.perk_text: Reduces incoming damage from damaging status effects on self by 30%. (Reworked in Y2S1; original Y1S3 perks: while under the effect of Ablaze, Flooded or Stormstruck, ramming an enemy ship spreads the status effect to the target; increases duration of Ablaze, Flooded or Stormstruck on self by 30%; reduces incoming damage from Ablaze, Flooded or Stormstruck on self by 10%.) Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Shot Carving Station
furniture.perk_text: Yer kiss your mother with those cannons?! Hitting a weakpoint applies Taunting Charge on the target. Increases Taunt Duration by 15%. Reduces Reload Time of Piercing weapons by 5%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Spikes Station
furniture.perk_text: Hitting a weakpoint has a 40% chance of reducing all Repair effects on the target by 75% for 15 seconds, regardless of the source. This chance increases to 30%... (sources conflict on the Flooded-target bonus; base chance was 25% before the Y2S1 buff to 40%.) Also listed in some sources as 'Spiteful Spikes Station'. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Chained Links
furniture.perk_text: While trimming sails, reduces incoming Weakpoint Damage by 60% at the cost of 10 Crew Stamina per hit. Reduces incoming damage to weakpoints by 20%. (Original Y1S4 values: 50% at 10% stamina per hit, 15% weakpoint damage reduction, +10% armor rating; buffed in Y2S1.) Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Pain-Piper
furniture.perk_text: Getting hit by a Crew Attack increases damage of your next Crew Attack by 80%. Decreases incoming Crew Attack damage by 10%. Increases Maximum Stamina by 5%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Drowned One's Toll
furniture.perk_text: When above 60% of Crew Stamina and below Max Hull Health, 6% of Crew Stamina is consumed to restore 0.28% of Hull Health per second. Increases Max Hull Health by 8%. Increases Crew Stamina Recovery Speed by 6% while out of combat. (Original Y1S4 values: 0.25%/s, +5% max hull, +3% stamina recovery; buffed in Y2S1.) Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Teuling's Guidance
furniture.perk_text: Reduces Reload Time of Front Weapons by 5% (reduced from 7% in Y2S1 balance patch). Other perks of this furniture could not be verified from available sources. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Wyrm's Breath Churner
furniture.perk_text: Triggering Shell-shocked on the target increases the Reload Time of their weapons by 25% for 20s. Increases Secondary Damage of Explosive Weapons by 25%. Increases weapon damage of Explosive Weapons by 5%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Bilgefire Barrels
furniture.perk_text: Weapon hits against a target with a damaging status effect have a 5% chance to fully recharge those status effects. This effect has a 30s cooldown. Increases Secondary Damage of Broadside weapons by 10%. Increases Broadside weapons damage by 5%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Mark of the Wolf
furniture.perk_text: Triggering Ablaze on the target also increases Shell-shocked charge rate by 50% for 7s (reduced from 100% for 10s in Y2S1 balance patch). Increases Fire Rate of Explosive weapons by 20%. Increases damage to structures by 5%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Emergency Locker
furniture.perk_text: Reduces duration of all damaging status effects applied to your ship by 50% but increases damage dealt by these effects by 15%. Reduces incoming Secondary Damage by 10%. Increases Max Hull Health by 6%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Buoy Locker I
furniture.perk_text: Increases the number of buoys your Springloader can launch for healing allies or devastating enemies. Exact numbers could not be verified from available sources. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Dummy Springloader I
furniture.perk_text: Reduces duration of incoming Torn Sails effect by 25%. Reduces incoming Flooding Charge by 20%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Stinkpot Station
furniture.perk_text: A station patchworked together with La Peste's many designs. Deals 12% more Toxic weapon damage to bracing targets within 250m. Poisoned targets within 250m take 10% more damage. +8% Toxic damage. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Sheeting Winch Console
furniture.perk_text: A shelf of equipment that eases sailing maneuvers. +0.8% weapon damage per 1 knot of sailing speed. Dealing no damage for 5s while trimming reduces broadside reload time by 12% for 10s. +20% acceleration. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Gimbal Ring Stores
furniture.perk_text: For every Demi-Cannon weapon equipped, increase weapon damage of equipped weapons by 5%. +14% Demi-Cannon projectile speed. +12% Demi-Cannon maximum range. (Reworked in Y3S2; pre-Y3S2: hitting a target over 180m away increased Demi-Cannon damage by 17% for 12s.) Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Siphon Furnace
furniture.perk_text: A table used to optimize Toxic Weapons. Targets that are Poisoned take 10% more Toxic weapon damage (Smuggler Pass version lists 14%). +12% projectile speed. +10% maximum range. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Ballista Mount Smithy
furniture.perk_text: Dealing 2000 Ballista damage in a single hit marks the target for 20s. Marked targets take 12% more Ballista damage and more secondary damage from all sources. -18% Ballista charge time. +14% Ballista weakpoint damage. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Blubber Works
furniture.perk_text: After 4 consecutive hits on a sea monster, broadside reload time is reduced by 15% for 20s; missing resets the count. Consecutive weakpoint hits on sea monsters increase secondary damage by 10% per hit up to 40% for 5s. +10% weapon damage to sea monsters. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Royal Ramming Works
furniture.perk_text: Primary: Ramming instantly builds 50% of the Punctured status effect on the target and slows the target by 20% for 20s. Secondary: Punctured targets receive 15% more damage from Piercing weapons. Tertiary: Targets within 250m receive 7% more Punctured status charge. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: St. Elmo's Chains
furniture.perk_text: Primary: Dealing Electric damage to Flooded targets also deals 50% of the Electric damage to other nearby targets within 150m. Secondary: Deal 50% more Electric damage to Flooded targets. Tertiary: Increase the duration of the Flooded status on targets by 10%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.name: Infernal Artificer's Bench
furniture.perk_text: Primary: 60% of Explosive damage dealt to a target with Shell-shocked is dealt as Burning damage; 40% of the Burning damage dealt to a target with Ablaze is dealt as Explosive damage. Secondary: Increase Shell-Shocked and Ablaze charge rate by 10%. Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

furniture.perk_text: Increases the Charge Rate of the Punctured status effect on enemy targets already affected by the Flooded status effect by 50%. Increases Charge Rate of the Flooded status effect on a target by 16%.

Siege Weapons deal 4% increased weapon damage. Repair Weapons repair 7% more Hull Health. Increases Projectile Speed of Siege Weapons and Repair Weapons by 10%, except for Sea Fire and Auxiliary Weapons.

furniture.name: Caustic Spall Station

furniture.name: Leyden Vault Array

furniture.name: Apothecary Tool Bench

furniture.name: Emergency Sails

furniture.name: Plaguebringer's Ward

furniture.name: Hubac Tuning Rack

furniture.name: Tuning Station
furniture.perk_text: Increases Secondary Damage of Torpedo by 20%. Increases Projectile Speed of Torpedo by 13%. Increases Crew Stamina restored per second while out of combat by 10%. (All buffed in the Y2S1 balance patch from 17%/10%/5%.) Only one Major Furniture can be installed per ship.

notes: Covers Year 1 Season 0 (launch) through Year 3 Season 2 (Crimson Waters, current as of 2026-10-02). Ship ranks now extend to 33. The 10 entries marked verified_from_gameplay:true are ground truth from the player's 2026-10-01 warehouse screenshots. GAPS: (1) cost_secondary: the parenthetical second number on some in-game costs (e.g. 80 (400), 80 (160)) is recorded verbatim where known but its meaning is unconfirmed; Game8 lists blueprint costs in Pieces of Eight that may correspond (e.g. Grindstone I blueprint costs 400 Po8).
